# Setting getter by id

Returns a setting by setting id; the debug getter Caduceus and OM-Emu call.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x603f0111` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Distinct from the capture-safe getter at 0x60063380. Caduceus reports that calling another getter, 0x603f039d, during a capture rebooted the camera. Setting names are in container block 2 per body.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Paired with the E-M1 II getter by OM-Emu's port table. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
- **Emulator** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): Called in the lab for ids 111, 901, 1578, 6, 1632, 1699 and 4000; each returned at once. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
